items.criterion: Two simultaneous claims on the last allocation of a release leave exactly one hold.
items.judgment: Fire both claims together and count the live allocation rows.

items.criterion: Held plus booked seats of a session never exceed its capacity under simultaneous holds.
items.judgment: Fire two holds for the whole capacity and sum the stored seats.

items.criterion: A sign-in link request delivers a message titled with the sign-in subject that opens with the code.
items.judgment: Request a link for a new address and read the Mailpit inbox.

items.criterion: A granted hold is stored in state held for the claiming account with a seventy-two-hour expiry.
items.judgment: Claim as a fresh visitor, then read the cellar and the allocation row.

items.criterion: A released hold is offered to the first waitlisted visitor with a mailed offer.
items.judgment: Hold, queue, release, then read the waiting visitor's shelf and inbox.

items.criterion: A visitor changing a venue stock reading is denied and the reading is unchanged.
items.judgment: Call the stock endpoint as a visitor and read the stock row.

items.criterion: A stock reading older than seventy-two hours is reported as unknown.
items.judgment: Query venues near Soho for mint and read The Gilded Nave's stock.

items.criterion: A venue query in a restricted region returns the region with no venues.
Venues within five kilometres of Soho list The Gilded Nave then Salt & Vesper with their distances.
items.judgment: Query venues near Soho with radius five and three.

items.criterion: A host setting a nearby reading fires a matching alert exactly once by mail.
items.judgment: Set an alert, update the reading twice as the host, then count the messages.

items.criterion: A booking converts a seat hold and sends one confirmation message.
items.judgment: Hold seats, book, then read the booking and the inbox.

items.criterion: Cancelling a booking inside forty-eight hours is refused as late.
items.judgment: Book the Late Pour session and try to cancel it.

items.criterion: The sixth new ritual save within an hour is refused with a cooldown.
items.judgment: Save six distinct rituals as one visitor.

items.criterion: A public ritual read carries no owner identity.
items.judgment: Read the seeded ritual publicly and scan the body.

items.criterion: The home page HTML carries the whole story text with the flavours, strength and volume.
items.judgment: Fetch the home page and read its text.

items.criterion: The content document lists the three flavours with their tint tokens and tasting notes.
The film is drawn as engraved hatching in ink, paper and red.
items.judgment: A person drives the film and decides.

items.criterion: A signed-out keep returns the visitor to the same flavour with the hold placed.
items.judgment: A person walks the keep journey and decides.
